id.description: Flow Map id, auto generated when map is created

name.description: Flow Map name, must be unique. Name should not have special characters. Valid characters are A-Z, a-z, 0-9, '&','_','=','|'

folderComment.description: Folder comment. Required if a new folder name is specified, which has to be created.

ruleSetId.description: The id of the rule set. Each rule set must have a unique ruleSetId

priority.description: The priority of the rule set. The lower the number the higher the precedence

aepId.description: Traffic is forwarded to this AEP if it does not match any drop rules and matches at least 1 pass rule.

passRules.description: Flow Map Pass Rules. Only used in traffic and inclusion maps. Not relevant for exclusion maps.

dropRules.description: Flow Map Drop Rules. Only used in traffic and exclusion maps. Not relevant for inclusion maps.

matches.description: A set of rule's matching elements. Within a rule, matching elements of the the same type may be repeated. However, their matching positions must be unique.

pos.description: Only applicable in a context of 'secondLevel/byRule' map rule. Value of 0 represents 'any' position

value.description: Ethernet Type as 2-byte hex value. For example - 0x0800.

valueMax.description: Ethernet Type as 2-byte hex value. For example - 0x0800. Only applicable in a context of secondLevel/byRule map rule. If present, 'valueMax' must be greater than 'value'

matchType.description: Indicates whether 'value' is a Regex pattern or a plain value to find

offsetStart.description: Starting postion for the pattern matching. If the reference protocl header type is included, counted after the corresponding protocol header. Otherwise, counted from the beginning of the packet.

offsetEnd.description: End postion for ranged pattern matching. If included, pattern matching. If included, pattern match is considered as a ranged match. Must be greater than 'offsetStart'.

pos.description: Protocol header position. Could be 1 or 2. If omitted, outer header is used
